description: This Java class implements a command strategy to retrieve loan interest pauses by external ID within a batch processing context. It interacts with the LoanInterestPauseApiResource to fetch data and serializes the response. The class is part of the internal batch command framework in the Fineract project.

classes.name: GetLoanInterestPausesByExternalIdCommandStrategy
classes.description: A Spring component that implements CommandStrategy to fetch interest pause data for a loan identified by external ID.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a batch request to retrieve loan interest pauses by external ID, interacts with the API resource, serializes the response, and constructs a BatchResponse.
